verdict.rationale: Anytype exposes a local API, an official MCP server, and an 'Agents Skill' that let external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, etc.) read, search, and modify Objects and run scripts against a user's data — this enables AI-driven analysis but is framed as connecting third-party agents rather than a built-in feature that surfaces insights/suggestions inside the app UI itself. Missing for 10: evidence of native, in-product AI-generated insights/suggestions (e.g., automatic summaries, recommendations) surfaced directly in the Anytype interface, and independent/hands-on confirmation that these AI integrations actually produce such insights.
